title: Wake up the B flower
story: A sleepy blue flower is waiting for one warm, steady B.
childCue: Cover thumb and hole 1. Whisper doo, then let B float.
adultCue: Check the left thumb and first finger are sealing their holes. Invite gentle air rather than a big blow.
successCue: B heard you. The first flower is awake!
tips: Left hand goes at the top.
Soft air makes the kindest sound.
